checks.detail: Three runs inside unshare -rn for 1, 5 and 20 tunnels. Worker per tunnel: about 16 MiB PSS per extra tunnel (346 MiB at 20), about 66 ms start per tunnel; one core: about 45 MiB flat. CPU per MiB and idle CPU equal. Established connections survive PUT /configs in both. After kill -9 of one tunnel the others carry traffic 19/19 with workers and 0/19 with one core. Decision in ADR-WORKER-TOPOLOGY.md: worker per tunnel.

not_closed: Parallel worker start is a controller question (I06), not measured.
